title: Crawler Discovery Artifact
description: Human-facing contract for signed crawler discovery artifacts landing in discovered/. Enforcement is hand-rolled in tools/rule-ingestion/discovered-verify.mjs.

discovered_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the crawler run completed.

crawler_version.description: Git SHA hex of the crawler commit that produced this artifact. 7–40 hex characters.

corpus.description: Lowercase hostnames the crawler analyzed during this run.

candidates.description: Discovered tracking parameter candidates. An empty array is a valid heartbeat run.

first_seen_on.description: Lowercase hostname where this parameter was first observed.

injected_by.description: Identifier of the injecting system or script.

occurrence_count.description: Number of times this parameter was observed during the run.

value_entropy.description: Mean Shannon entropy (bits) of observed URL parameter values.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the canonical JSON (keys sorted, signature field removed). Lowercase hex, exactly 128 characters (64 raw bytes).
